subject: POC infrastructure options, success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@mediwell.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@mediwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 17:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Mediwell - Infrastructure options & success criteria

Hi Sam / Elena — thanks again for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can get you into a POC next week. I tried to keep this tight so you can share with your infra & security folks.

Summary of ask from call:
- Validate model parity and latencies for conversational triage workflows (up to 1,000 concurrent chats during business hours)
- Confirm PHI handling controls and network boundaries for pilot data
- Evaluate cost and per-token unit economics for both short and long sequences (avg 120 tokens per request)

Recommended trial hosting options (we can run any of these):
1) Hosted API sandbox (fastest) — Redwood-managed, quick signup, streaming responses. Pros: fastest to start, minimal ops. Cons: not ideal for PHI without add'l controls.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool) — single-tenant compute in our infra, predictable throughput, can run production-scale 95th-pct latency tests. Pros: performance parity, easier to compare costs. Cons: 3–5 business days to provision.
3) VPC trial (preferred for PHI) — private networking, customer-managed ingress, KMS integration for keys. Pros: meets strict data residency/security asks; Cons: longer setup and firewall changes.

Success criteria (what you told us + our proposal):
- Latency: p95 <= 450ms for standard prompt set at 512 tokens
- Throughput: sustain 600 requests/minute during peak window with 95% success rate
- Quality: intent detection F1 >= 0.88 against your seed eval set (we'll run the eval you shared)
- Security: VPC or equivalent isolation and keys managed by MediWell if PHI is used
- Cost benchmark: baseline cost per 1M tokens under $X (we'll provide roughs once hosting is chosen)

Proposal / timeline:
- Day 0 (your signoff): agree on hosting option and success criteria; exchange allowlist & NDA if needed
- Day 1–3: provision hosted sandbox OR spin up dedicated sandbox OR begin VPC onboarding (VPC takes longer; expect 7–10 business days for full network changes)
- Day 4–7: ingest seed evaluation data, run initial smoke tests, share latency/cost dashboard
- Week 2: run scaled load run and quality eval; capture results and go/no-go checklist
Who should own what (please confirm):
- MediWell: IT owner for allowlist & firewall (placeholder: Elena Morales)
- MediWell: product/ML owner for eval data and scoring (placeholder: Sam Patel)
- Redwood: infra provisioning and runbooks (Irene)
- Redwood: Dedicated sandbox quote & capacity plan (Marissa)
Action items for you: please confirm preferred hosting option and the IT contact for allowlist + whether pilot data will include PHI (even in pseudonymized form). I attached a short success criteria spreadsheet and a one-page comparison of hosting options.

Attachments: poc_success_criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_trial_options.pdf (one-pager)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up tomorrow to lock in the path.

—
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@mediwell.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: Mediwell - Infrastructure options & success criteria

Irene — thanks, this is great and clear. A couple quick clarifications:

- PHI: we do need VPC isolation for the pilot; our compliance team won't approve shared-hosted for any PHI. We can start with a small de-identified dataset but would like keys in our KMS.
- Timeline: can we compress the VPC onboarding? If Redwood can provide a minimal-scope VPC to run smoke tests (no full firewall rules) within 48–72 hours, we can postpone a larger change window to a later phase.
- Cost: please provide an initial Dedicated vs VPC estimate — ballpark numbers are fine, we just need to factor into our budget review this week.

Happy to have Elena coordinate IT with you. Can you include any IPs or egress rules you'll need so our firewall team can pre-approve?

Sam
Director of Product, MediWell Health
sam.patel@mediwell.com

Sam / Elena — quick update and plan: thanks for the clarity on PHI. We can do a two-phase approach to meet your security needs while accelerating time-to-insight.

Phase A (48–72h smoke):
- Provision a minimal-scope VPC trial with restricted egress IPs and KMS-enabled keys. This environment will accept only a non-PHI test dataset and allows us to validate latency + basic evals. Redwood will provide the IP allowlist and a short KMS integration template.

Phase B (full pilot):
- Once IT approves, expand VPC rules to accept larger datasets and enable the full KMS workflow. If your timeline requires, we can stand up a Dedicated sandbox in parallel and cutover results to VPC later.

Deliverables & owners (confirmed):
- IP allowlist + KMS template (Ben Carter, Redwood) — will send in the next 2 hours
- Dedicated sandbox cost + provisioning ETA (Marissa Cole, Redwood) — ballpark within 4 business hours
- POC success criteria spreadsheet + eval plan (Irene) — I've attached a Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Qw_poc-plan-miw

Next steps for MediWell:
- Elena: confirm IT point-of-contact for firewall updates and whether we can get pre-approval for the example IPs (or provide alternate)
- Sam: confirm whether initial smoke dataset will be fully de-identified (this allows Phase A to proceed faster)

I will also open a HubSpot deal note and create a short runbook in the linked Drive so both teams can track evidence and results. If you want an NDA before we exchange any exported data, use this DocuSign template: https://www.docusign.com/templates/mediwell-nda-2026

Attachments: vpc_requirements_template.csv (internal checklist)

Looking forward — we'll get IPs + cost table over shortly.
